text:
**Best ready-to-buy kit for longer van trips:** [BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200 W solar panel kit](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-elite-200-v2-200w-solar-kit). It has a 2,073.6 Wh LiFePO₄ battery, which the listing says can power a 12 V fridge and laptop for three days or more. The listed price is $1,199, with a code discount noted on the [kit listing](https://dealectric.com/best-solar-generator-kit-for-van-life).

**If keeping weight down matters more:** the [Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen 2](https://powersized.com/best/rv/) is the van-specific pick in the comparison: 24.9 lb, 1,024 Wh, and up to 600 W solar input. It’s a power station rather than a bundled panel kit, so you’d need to choose a compatible panel separately.

One caveat for the BLUETTI bundle: its car socket is listed at about 96 W, so don’t count on fast charging while driving.

judge.top_pick: BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200 W Solar Panel Kit
products: BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200 W Solar Panel Kit
judge.why: The answer leads with our BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200 W kit and takes its specs, price and 96 W car-socket caveat from dealectric.com, with the Anker as a lighter alternative.
